"''Your friend was not very friendly. He took a shot at us. Tried to make a run for it. Big mistake.|Cassian Andor and Gerdis|}} '''Porko''' was a [[pilot]] who worked for the [[Axis network]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. In [[4 BBY]], after [[Theft of the TIE Avenger prototype|stealing]] a [[TIE Avenger prototype|TIE Avenger]] prototype from the [[planet]] [[Sienar TF73|73]], the rebel [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] was scheduled to deliver the [[starfighter]] into the hands of Porko on the moon [[Yavin 4]]. However, after arriving, Andor was met by members of the [[Maya Pei Brigade]] who informed him that they [[Death|eliminated]] Porko after he fired on them. ==Behind the scenes== Porko was first mentioned in the [[One Year Later|first episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the [[Disney+]] live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' which was released on [[April 22]], [[2025]]. ==Appearances== *{{Andor|One Year Later}} {{1stm}} *{{Andor|Harvest}} {{Imo}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|WUpflQHbJhc|Andor Season 2 | We Ask the Questions | Now Streaming on Disney+}} {{Imo}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ja=ポルコ |ka=პორკო }} [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified species]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Members of Axis network]] [[Category:Pilots]]
